thread_analysis.thread_summary: Premium Audio Company (Onkyo GX10 Powered Speaker) registration completion thread. Allion completed SIG registration referencing two QDIDs, then requested four product documents from the customer for Compliance Folder creation. A minor issue arose where the customer's shared cloud link was restricted to a specific named email (yukihiro.nakano) and not accessible to Allion, requiring re-sharing. Allion then shipped the CD-R Compliance Folder. The thread closes with an invoice from Allion and a reminder about free derivative product addition via Manage Submitted Products.
all_questions_found: What documents are needed for the Compliance Folder after registration?
How can future derivative models using the same module and Host Stack be added to the registration?
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: The four required Compliance Folder documents are: (1) operation manual (Bluetooth section), (2) block diagram, (3) outline drawing, (4) antenna datasheet with radiation gain characteristics. These are standard requirements for all registrations under QPRDv3. The thread also reinforces the rule that derivative products with the same module and Host Stack can be added free to the existing Product List via Manage Submitted Products — no additional SIG registration or fee required.
thread_analysis.key_decision_logic: Compliance Folder is mandatory per SIG rules and must be retained until 1 year after the last registered product is discontinued. Free derivative addition is only valid when both module and Host Stack are identical to the original registration.
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Incomplete Compliance Folder leaves the customer vulnerable to a failed SIG audit. Separate registration for identical-module derivatives wastes the customer's money.
thread_analysis.consulting_mistake: None observed. The thread shows a well-managed post-registration flow with proactive reminder about derivative product addition.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Always remind customers of the free derivative product addition path immediately after registration completion. Ensure cloud document sharing links are broadly accessible before following up repeatedly on document submissions.
